definitions.gloss: weekly; held every week; regular weekly event
definitions.explanation: Something that takes place on a regular weekly basis. Most commonly used for meetings, reports, and other recurring business activities.

examples.japanese: {週例|しゅうれい}{会議|かいぎ}は{月曜日|げつようび}だ。
examples.english: The weekly meeting is on Monday.

examples.japanese: {週例|しゅうれい}{報告|ほうこく}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
{今週|こんしゅう}の{週例|しゅうれい}ミーティングでは、{新|あたら}しいプロジェクトの{進捗|しんちょく}を{確認|かくにん}する{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: At this week's regular meeting, we plan to check the progress of the new project.

notes:
A business and organizational term combining {週|しゅう} (week) and {例|れい} (regular; customary). Almost always used as a modifier before another noun.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {週例|しゅうれい}{会議|かいぎ}: weekly meeting
- {週例|しゅうれい}{報告|ほうこく}: weekly report
- {週例|しゅうれい}ミーティング: weekly meeting
- {週例|しゅうれい}{定例|ていれい}{会|かい}: weekly regular meeting

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {月例|げつれい}: monthly (regular event)
- {日例|にちれい}: daily (regular event)
- {定例|ていれい}: regular; periodic — more general, not limited to weekly
- {毎週|まいしゅう}: every week — adverb of frequency, not used as a modifier for recurring events
